title: Sofia: Name Meaning, Origin & Personality
summary: Sofia is a classic name that means wisdom. It sounds beautiful in almost every language and has been a favourite for generations.
origin: Sofia comes from the Ancient Greek word 'sophia', which means wisdom. The word is also the root of 'philosophy', the love of wisdom. The name spread through Europe in the early centuries and became popular among royal families, which helped it travel to Spain, Italy, Portugal, Russia and Scandinavia. Today Sofia is used in dozens of countries, and the spelling Sophia is common in English and German.
personality: Sofia is often associated with intelligence, curiosity and calm good sense, just like its meaning. People imagine a Sofia as thoughtful and wise beyond her years, a good listener who gives balanced advice. The name also has a warm, elegant feel, suggesting someone kind, cultured and confident. Many see Sofias as natural organisers who stay gentle and patient even when things get busy.
popularity: Sofia is one of the most popular girls' names in Italy, Spain, Portugal, Mexico, Argentina, Chile and Colombia, and it is also very common in Sweden, Russia and Ukraine. Sophia has been near the top of name lists in the United States and Germany for many years.

faq.q: What does the name Sofia mean?
faq.ans: Sofia means 'wisdom' in Ancient Greek. It is the same word found in 'philosophy'.

faq.q: What is the difference between Sofia and Sophia?
faq.ans: They are the same name. Sofia is the usual spelling in Spanish, Italian and Portuguese, while Sophia is more common in English and German.

faq.q: Is Sofia used in Arabic-speaking countries?
faq.ans: Yes, Sofia (صوفيا) is increasingly chosen by families in North Africa and the Middle East who like international names. It is easy to pronounce in Arabic.

faq.q: What are cute nicknames for Sofia?
faq.ans: Sofi, Fifi and Sophie are the most common nicknames. In Spanish-speaking families Sofi is especially popular.
